reviews.reason: No implemented interface establishes a finite water source, withdraws conserved water, or retains it for a material test. Gathering exposed materials and the existing wet trials are not equivalent. Develop a minimal bank-access, direct-contact and portable-water mechanism. Nearby river terrain permits inspection, not an automatic finding of safe reach, usable water or drinking safety. The remote vine specimen is not acted upon by this review.
reviews.experienceReview: Actual paid inspection or a performed wet comparison may establish previously unknown access or material behavior. Subscribe information-confirmed with interface access-water to the existing grounded-understanding source: only the acting observer, qualified new observed information, 0.8 transient amount, cap 1, eight-round duration, refresh repetition and 12-round cooldown; maintained gain 0.035 per eligible event with existing 0.0015 decay and the source's bounded saturation. Share deduplication with probe and material assays: the same access fact or wet-test result cannot pay twice. Repeated known filling, cup fabrication, requesting and learning receive no curiosity or mastery reward. No separate maintained satisfaction source is warranted merely for possessing water; no hydration, nutrition, health or protected mental-account changes are implied.
reviews.visualReview: Declare water-access-inspected, water-cup-progress, water-cup-completed, water-withdrawn, material-contact-wetted, water-spilled, water-cup-failed and water-operation-stopped for subscription validation, alongside existing information-confirmed. Render cups and work footprints at their shared physical coordinates, with visible fill level, wet clay condition, spills and failure remnants. Replay events include actor, source/cup/specimen IDs, location, before/after volumes and masses, paid energy, stage and remaining work. Inspection overlays distinguish observed reachable surface, blocked reach and uncertainty; they must not display a remote test as completed or water as potable.
reviews.specification:
Implement river-contact-water@1 through the current development handoff. Public interface access-water: strict schema {mode:inspect|form-cup|fill|wet|inspect-cup|resume|cancel, target:string, container:string, project:string, quantityMl:integer>=0, x:number,y:number}; unused references empty, unused quantities/coordinates zero. References resolve exact persistent IDs, optionally one appropriate item:/object: prefix, never resource aliases. Targets may also identify an inspected river surface cell. Personal study: two rounds; no simulation time passes during implementation.
State and physical dependencies: use the authoritative river-terrain polygon, shared collision geometry and current water conditions. Add versioned finite surface-water compartments only on actual river cells: initially 10 litres per square metre of wetted area, representing a declared 1 cm withdrawable surface layer, not measured actor knowledge or an unlimited river supply. No automatic replenishment in this minimal version. Persist cell volume, withdrawals, provenance and contamination-unknown status. Inspection reports geometric access and estimated available volume, not potability. If authoritative river geometry does not establish a water surface, report unresolved access without creating one.
Access: actor remains on supported non-water terrain; interaction segment to water or apparatus must be <=0.65, clear of solids, and not require entering water. Coordinate x=26 alone does not establish reach from (25,15). Inspection costs one round/0.2 energy and records actual bank/surface geometry and uncertainty. It neither moves the actor nor wets a remote specimen.
Executable portable precursor: form-cup uses 0.5 kg of explicitly owned wet clay at a clear reachable work footprint, three stages of one round/0.5 energy each. Reject inadequate quantity before allocation; partition material precisely by mass. Persist a hand-formed open cup, 0.1 litre capacity, 0.03 m outer radius, 0.07 m height, clay provenance and remaining wall mass. This is fragile unfired clay, not ceramic. Declare model law: when holding water, lose 1 ml water and 0.1 g wall clay per round into an actual located spill containing clay sediment; at wall mass below 0.45 kg, collapse, spilling remaining water and retaining all clay as wet fragments. Carrying or dropping updates actual location and load; ordinary collision damage also applies. No insulation, sterilization or food-safety effects.
Fill: reachable inspected river compartment plus actual accessible cup, positive quantityMl within free capacity and remaining source volume; one round/0.3 energy. Atomically debit source and credit cup, preserving source/time lineage. Wet: exact locally accessible specimen accepted by an existing material-test contract; one round/0.3 energy. Use 10 ml per 0.1 material unit as the initial versioned contact-water dose, rounded upward to whole ml. Withdraw either from a reachable inspected river compartment for immediate contact or from an explicit local cup. Transfer water into the specimen's tracked moisture and subsequent runoff/evaporation, not an unexplained deletion. Bind this operation to assay-woven-supports so its actual wet stage can consume this dose and proceed only with its own remaining paid work and local specimen. It supplies no pass certificate. No ingestion operation is introduced.
Contracts: persist operation ID, owner, exact escrow IDs, paid stages, actual remaining work and completion flag. Insufficient energy/access pauses without charge. Resume executes only remaining stages; repeat starts a new fully costed operation. Cancellation, incompatible action or death cancels attended multi-round work and releases surviving escrow once at its actual location; never clone, delete or refund used material/effort. Completed cups and passive leakage persist independently. Concurrent withdrawals use atomic shared locks. Migration leaves existing waterless trials paused and existing objects unchanged; never backfill water or rewrite evidence. Record any reused resolver, escrow and wet-trial code separately from this new function.

review: Implements Lin's actual round-194 request and accepted world-138 review, with two personal study rounds and no granted inventory, cup or mastery. Reuses only this run's actual woven comparison and generic resolver/operation/mass/visual primitives. Exact visible river-cell identities extend the shared resolver; repeated inspection cannot refill compartments or reveal hidden cells. Paid inspection reports actual supported-bank geometry and uncertainty, while withdrawal requires a clear <=0.65 hand segment and personal inspection. The finite 10-litre per cell, non-replenishing one-centimetre surface layer is an explicit model assumption, with any previously represented withdrawals debited; not measured potability. Forming partitions actual wet clay in three 0.5-energy stages, retains exact surplus and produces an empty fragile 0.5 kg wall/100 ml vessel. Original escrow identity, provenance, stages and paid effort survive serialization and access/energy pauses. Explicit cancellation, incompatible action or death returns surviving clay once; completed repetition starts a new fully paid operation. Cups preserve whole-item identity across pickup/drop/handoff and actual contents affect load. Each wet round transfers one ml and 0.1 g wall clay into located audited deposits. Actual below-threshold wall failure or mechanical impact spills contents and retains all fragments. Failed navigation, hunger and thermal injury are not mechanical impacts. An installed-package-only post-environment hook is protected by the same immutable rules, personal mastery, life and wellbeing-account guard as processes; a regression rejects unearned mastery. Same-round source contention preserves the existing all-conflicting-actions-rejected rule without duplicate debit. Paid local contact consumes the exact 10 ml per 0.1 specimen-unit dose from an inspected source or actual cup, preserves the real dry baseline, transfers moisture/runoff and leaves the original personal comparison to pay and execute its remaining stage. No remote completion or automatic certificate; useful evidence uses existing deduplicated understanding, not filling, ownership, learning or manufacture. The actual-owned-item observation now shows the holder location after installation, correcting a stale coordinate without changing physical inventory. A separately reviewed generic-process correction uses actual physical mass, demands explicit water/solid-conserving outputs, and retains prior metadata/composition in escrow and cancellation; it has no earlier formal executions. Fourteen water and three process regressions pass, with seventeen existing open/woven tests also passing. Types, lint, architecture, build and selected browser assertions pass. Five final isolated images were actually inspected: bank access, partial paid forming, filled cup, carrying and retained collapse deposits. The wear-boundary scene is an explicitly authored near-failure fixture, not formal elapsed wear. Diagnostic inputs with the new contract remain below the original cap without another encoding or policy change (53224/58775/57399 characters); no long-term guarantee is claimed. Full unfiltered tests and exact 194-round world/event/task reconstruction are mandatory before activation.
